comparisons.evidence: P's "Client Continuity Cooperative" removes a major barrier to earning income, while "Frailty Escrow" addresses catastrophic loss of autonomy. Q's "Personal Technical Rider" and "Grandparenting Stagecraft" reduce important setup and family-role frictions, but generally produce less consequential gains.

Q's "Reversible Commitment Layer" directly makes obligations expire and its "Personal Technical Rider" directly tests accommodation compatibility. P's "Frailty Escrow" depends on legally executable cross-jurisdiction authority, while its cooperative assumes expert work can be documented and substituted without substantial quality loss.

Q can prototype its rider with a spreadsheet, its relay with "20 overnight reviews," and its family product with envelopes. P's strongest ideas require harder institutional machinery: "pooled underwriting," a legally structured escrow, property-operator process changes, or reliable backup professionals.

P concretely specifies that cooperative members "document their recurring work, nominate compatible backups, and contract through the cooperative." Q similarly defines the rider's variables, property certification and arrival test; both outputs provide understandable users, workflows and falsifiable prototypes.

P offers credible reframings such as belonging through "being needed" and converting irregular retirees into a reliable pooled supplier. Q is comparably inventive in treating time-zone difference as "inventory," distance as a storytelling mechanic and commitments as things that should "decay by default."

P's strongest range covers work continuity, housing underwriting, incapacity governance and role-based belonging. Q spans those broad concerns through distinct additional levers including environmental certification, asynchronous time-zone exchange, automatic obligation expiry, physical family play, knowledge inheritance and rehearsed failure procedures.

P's final portfolio concentrates attention on four central continuity failures: client trust, housing credibility, diminished capacity and belonging. Q also selects strong ideas, but weaker additions such as "Move Condition Receipt," "Identity Capsule" and "Proxy Presence Appliance" dilute the portfolio with diagnostic or accessory-like value.
